entries.english:
Guardianship by Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg, Gotfried von Seckendorf zu Untern- and Obernzenn, and Eberhard von Eltershofen zu Ippesheim over the children Georg Albrecht, Philipp Ludwig, and Anna Margareta of the late Hans Georg von Seckendorf zu Sugenheim (vol. 2).

Term: 1599–1617, 1630.

Contents: (1) Deposition and arrest of the pastor Johann Heck at Sugenheim for unchristian conduct, 1604; (2) travel accounts of the young lords von Seckendorff, kept by their stewards Johann Glock at Ingelfingen and Jakob Schütz, 1613–1614; (3) mediation by Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg in disputes between Georg Albrecht and Philipp Ludwig von Seckendorf, 1630.

Extent: 1 volume.
